findings:
🔵 [shallow-clone-base-derivation] CUT/FOLLOW-UP In a depth-limited clone the graft boundary commit looks like the introducing commit and its parent is absent, so BASE_SHA is empty and the suite fails at the BASE_OK assertion. Excluded because the spec asks for exactly this loud failure when derivation fails; an optional later hardening is a message hinting `git fetch --unshallow`.
🔵 [pinned-receipt-archive-path] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The AUTOPILOT_PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_RECEIPT value is a hard-coded dated archive path (docs/projects/_archive/2026/08/...), so moving that archive would break both runs. Excluded because the break is loud (the new per-run 'ARGV:' assertions fail) and the pin is spec-mandated; an optional later step is hoisting the path into a variable with an existence assertion.
